title: Ancient South American 'bird' models resembling airplanes
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Ancient South American 'bird' models resembling airplanes, about Thousands of years ago at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Greg Rogers, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025 as a NASA doctor who says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, mentions small ancient models from South America that are usually called birds. He suggests they look like airplanes, which, if so, would mean people thousands of years ago knew about flying machines.
